items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: General Marshall came through there and took that plush job from us in Honolulu.

ctx.x: Because we got into Honolulu and we had a layover there to wait for this bucket job because General Marshall came through there and took that plush job from us in Honolulu.

Wait, (Unintelligible), Charlie. They were waiting for General Marshall when we got there, because all the troops were out there waiting for him. See. General Marshall flew right in, he was about a half an hour behind us, because all the troops were out there, dressed up.
